skills: 认识新朋友时主动问候（Hello!/Hi!）
介绍自己的名字（My name is ... / You can call me ...）
欢迎外国朋友（Welcome to China!）
初次见面礼貌用语（Nice to meet you.）
拓展：询问姓名 What's your name?

sections.title: Listen and circle. 听一听，圈出符合录音的图片
Look and match. 看图，把图片和单词连起来
sections.answers: friend—朋友图；name—姓名牌；welcome—欢迎新朋友图。

sections.title: Read and choose. 读一读，选择合适的应答
sections.answers: 1A 2A 3A 4A 5A（Hello!→Hi!；My name is Shenshen.→Hi, Shenshen.；Welcome to China!→Thank you.；Nice to meet you.→Nice to meet you.；You can call me Lily.→Hi, Lily.）

sections.title: Choose the right words. 根据情境，圈出正确表达
sections.answers: 1 Nice to meet you. 2 My name is Minmin. 3 Welcome to China! 4 You can call me Lily.

sections.title: Speaking task. 口语小任务（家长/老师评分）
sections.answers: 按"主动问候、清楚说姓名、表达得体"综合评分。

sections.title: Listen and number. 听录音，按听到的顺序给场景编号1-5
Complete the dialogue. 从词语框中选出合适的表达，填序号
sections.answers: 1A 2B 3C 4E 5D（A. Hello! B. My name is Lily. C. Welcome to China! D. Nice to meet you. E. You can call me Lily.）

sections.title: Read and match. 读一读，把表达和用途连起来
sections.answers: Hello/Hi—和新朋友打招呼；My name is—说出自己的名字；Welcome to China—欢迎新朋友；Nice to meet you—第一次见面。

sections.title: Choose by the situation. 根据情境，选择最合适的表达
sections.answers: 1A Nice to meet you, Lily. 2A My name is Xiaopu. 3A Hi, Lily. 4A Welcome to China!

sections.title: Extension. 拓展：询问姓名，选择正确的对话
sections.answers: A（What's your name? — My name is Minmin.）

sections.title: Speaking challenge. 口语挑战（家长/老师评分）
sections.answers: 能完成问候、说姓名和初次见面的礼貌表达即可。

usageNotes: 每题听力读两遍。书面题以听辨、认读和情境理解为主，不要求默写。What's your name? 为拓展，不作硬性得分点。原卷选择题答案多为A，App 内练习会打乱选项顺序。
